description: List the engines this OpenSERP backend can use and whether they work right now. Self-hosted: each engine with initialized and circuit_state (open means it is failing, skip it). Cloud: per-engine web/image support and status (operational, loaded, down) with latency. Read-only and free. Call it when searches keep failing, then pick a healthy engine for search or the engines list.
name: list_engines
title: List Engines
